Use the marked deployment records to answer the question. Cite the matching chunk IDs.

<sbproxy-retrieval>
<sbproxy-query>
Why did checkout-api fail to start after the 14:02 deployment?
</sbproxy-query>
<sbproxy-chunk id="release" format="text">
The checkout-api release began at 14:02. The deployment used image registry.internal/checkout:v184. Three replicas were requested. The release owner was the payments team.
</sbproxy-chunk>
<sbproxy-chunk id="events" format="text">
All new checkout-api pods entered ImagePullBackOff. The registry returned manifest unknown for checkout:v184. The previous v183 image remained available. The scheduler placed every pod successfully.
</sbproxy-chunk>
<sbproxy-chunk id="database" format="text">
Database latency stayed below 8 milliseconds during the release. No connection errors were recorded. The migration job completed before deployment.
</sbproxy-chunk>
<sbproxy-chunk id="network" format="text">
The service mesh reported healthy sidecars. DNS resolution and outbound registry connectivity both passed their probes. No network policy changed.
</sbproxy-chunk>
</sbproxy-retrieval>
